result: NEGATIVE - net P&L negative in all 3 cost scenarios (base -$268.63, conservative -$394.25, stress -$603.63 over 67 trades); GROSS P&L also negative (-$158.75) before any costs, so not purely a cost/execution problem. rationale: Dual moving-average crossover trend-following (fast SMA vs slow SMA, always-in-market stop-and-reverse) applied at intraday horizons per section 11E, since the source paper's own monthly-horizon result cannot be tested with the data this environment can reach
academic_source: P007 (Szakmary, Shen & Sharma 2010, JBF) -- mechanism only; exact original parameter grid could not be verified (sciencedirect/researchgate/semanticscholar/repec all blocked by network egress), so standard window pairs (5/20, 10/30, 20/50) were used instead, clearly NOT attributed as the paper's own values
feature_set: SMA(fast) vs SMA(close, slow), next-bar execution
number_of_variants_tested: 18 (3 instruments x 2 timeframes x 3 parameter pairs)
result: NOT ROBUST -- net P&L (base cost scenario) flips sign across the 3 neighbouring parameter pairs in 4 of 6 instrument/timeframe combos (MES 30min: +957/+1623/-3180; MGC 30min: +797/+1005/-3467; MCL 15min: -692/+615/+1867; also directionally mixed). Only MES 15min (all positive, +539/+1515/+1760) and MCL 30min (all positive, +1864/+3206/+2820) hold direction across all 3 pairs, and even those show large, non-monotonic swings in magnitude. MGC 15min is consistently NEGATIVE across all 3 pairs (-3766/-3051/-1900). See reports/backtests/DUAL_MA_XOVER_v1_parameter_stability.json.
reason_rejected: Section 21's own reject criterion: 'a parameter optimum is an isolated spike' -- this is exactly that pattern in most instrument/timeframe combinations. n_trades per test ranges 12-62, also below the 100-trade minimum (section 24). Not a rejection of the underlying trend-following literature (which is tested on monthly data over decades, not 15-95 days of intraday data) -- this only says the mechanism is not robust on the recent, short, high-frequency window available here.
whether_oos_was_viewed: no formal IS/OOS split - sample too small (see reason_rejected)
whether_idea_was_modified_after_oos: no - parameter grid was fixed (5/20, 10/30, 20/50) before any result was viewed
